notes.title: "Twilight bride:VORMSLEGEND"has now been turned into a full version.
notes.content:
[h2][b]《沃姆斯传说：午夜新娘》现已正式结束EA，转为正式发行版本。[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42391568/de5c93aacdd908db84431c7419e47cf21e7cf7cb.png[/img]
在神圣的教堂里，正在举办着一场特殊的婚礼。男主菲利普携手幽灵新娘爱丽丝，在大长老的见证下交换戒指。但与此同时，一位神秘的女士正在赶来的路上，原本平静美好的婚礼即将变得波澜起伏。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42391568/584d303ee525bec4253cb44c340ce4f5918b7160.png[/img]
[h3]【丰富多变的场景】[/h3]
地下世界中的重重困难，成就了伟大的冒险。昏暗的天空、密布的森林、充满食人鱼的河流，哥特风格的场景和角色，神秘中却又带着一丝魔幻色彩。当然，还有令人挠头的迷宫和各种古怪的谜题。要达成目的，你不仅需要勇气，更得开动脑筋，运用智慧的头脑。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42391568/e2900b0f9dee275e5f971e10fe6fdbecf47386a6.png[/img]
[h3]【新奇有趣的伙伴】[/h3]
一路上，你将与形形色色的人物展开对话。遇到一些有趣的小动物时，你将与他们携手同行，互相帮助，共同找寻隐藏的线索。动物伙伴都有其独特的特长和能力，如果你被困在某个场景，可以尝试让你的动物伙伴帮忙哦~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42391568/6241addc7671a28beb958dad8c63e4f17d971cc7.png[/img]
[h3]【大长老的收藏品】[/h3]
闲暇时刻不妨关注一下地图中的小惊喜。大长老平日里最喜欢收集塔罗牌，但是地底世界的小动物们总是会叼走他的收藏品，紧张探索之余也可关注下地图的角角落落，留心收集随机散落的塔罗牌，拼凑出属于你的艺术画廊吧。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42391568/9636ab72cca60ecc76cb71b6203cb66953c2de17.png[/img]

这场荒诞而绮丽的午夜之旅，等待你的加入。

notes.title: 《Twilight bride :VORMSLEGEND》new character Alice unlocked
notes.content:
On June 24, the legend of Wallace: the midnight bride ushered in a major update. I believe adventurers must be looking forward to this update. Let's take a look at what has been added!
[new main plot goes online]
In the first version, we entered the dark underworld from the perspective of "Philip" and looked for the trace of the ghost bride regardless of unknown dangers. The new main plot of the second character "Alice" brought by this update will protect the human "Philip" who broke into the underworld from unknown dangers underground from the perspective of Alice. After passing many tests, Alice Found the never withering rose that symbolizes love, and finally came to the wedding banquet hall
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42391568/e6609e2b79e910c34c279cf19968f4f0d7be1edc.png[/img]
[new pet partner joining]
This update will bring a new pet partner - Qiqi. As a squirrel living in the underground world for a long time, Qiqi is already familiar with the terrain here, and can easily climb various commanding heights. Where Alice can't go, maybe Qiqi can help!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42391568/1ba0bf45d891592e54a8f8d7046d56a396b7d85a.png[/img]
[new pet partner joining]
This update will bring a new pet partner - Qiqi. As a squirrel living in the underground world for a long time, Qiqi is already familiar with the terrain here, and can easily climb various commanding heights. Where Alice can't go, maybe Qiqi can help![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42391568/fae1a42901e6719874ef2763e5c7342419401d1e.png[/img]
[unveiling the new mysterious egg]
The game retains the same tarot card collection task as before. In this updated plot, funny colored eggs that are consistent with life experience are added (a little spoiler: Naughty Qiqi may bring you some negative effects!!).
In addition, there is a mysterious hidden ending waiting for you to explore. How to trigger it depends on the brain hole of the little partner!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42391568/889c9f20335c469ceb23ee8f0683b16f07373e7f.png[/img]

notes.title: 《Twilight bride :VORMSLEGEND》now officially launched
notes.content: Dear adventurer, the legend of WAMS: Midnight bride in your wish list is being promoted at a 10% discount. If you are interested in the mysterious midnight story, you might as well go into the game to find out.
